reasoning_traces.think:
The SSR endpoints represent a dual encoding of UI state and navigational logic. Each endpoint returns a pageProps dictionary containing mainNav and pageNav structures, which define hierarchical menus. These structures are parsed into a formal tree representation where each node has an identifier, component type, title, and optional sub-items. The static site generation flag (__N_SSG) provides a probabilistic indicator of whether the content is cached or dynamically generated. This allows GSI to model the likelihood of state transitions in GSE by observing how often these structures change across builds. Failure modes occur when buildId is invalid or when required fields like Title or __component are missing, leading to incomplete or malformed navigation trees.
